blocks.en: Master the six system designations in ISO 11608-1 (A, B1, B2, C, D1, D2) and what they mean for CDMO filling processes

blocks.en: Understand the practical meaning of the dose accuracy statistical symbols: V<sub>set</sub>, the k value, and α/β error

blocks.en: Be able to determine the correct System Designation of an NIS from the customer's product characteristics

blocks.zh: CDMO 最常見：D1 系統
blocks.en: The Most Common in CDMOs: The D1 System

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 無菌充填業務中，絕大多數 autoinjector 產品屬於 D1 分類：
blocks.en: In CDMO aseptic filling, the great majority of autoinjector products fall under designation D1:

blocks.zh: 整合式容器（PFS 固定在裝置內，不可替換）
blocks.en: Integrated container (the PFS is fixed inside the device and cannot be replaced)

blocks.zh: 單劑量（每次使用一支）
blocks.en: Single dose (one unit per use)

blocks.zh: 全量釋出（0.5 mL 或 1 mL，完全打出）
blocks.en: Full delivery (0.5 mL or 1 mL, completely expelled)

blocks.zh: D1 系統的劑量準確性評估使用 Dose Delivery Efficiency（剩餘量/充填量的計算），而非固定劑量的上下限判定。
blocks.en: Dose accuracy for a D1 system is assessed using Dose Delivery Efficiency (calculated from the residual volume relative to the fill volume), not by upper and lower limits on a fixed dose.

blocks.zh: 這意味著 CDMO 的充填精度（uniformity of fill）直接影響 D1 系統的 Dose Delivery Efficiency 合規性。
blocks.en: This means the CDMO's fill accuracy (uniformity of fill) directly affects whether a D1 system meets its Dose Delivery Efficiency requirement.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：A vs D1 的差異
blocks.en: Analogy: A vs. D1

blocks.zh: Designation A（胰島素筆型注射器）就像咖啡膠囊機：機器留在手上，用完換膠囊，每次可選不同份量。
blocks.en: Designation A (insulin pen injector) is like a coffee capsule machine: the machine stays in your hand, you swap in a new capsule when one is used up, and you can choose a different serving size each time.

blocks.zh: Designation D1（自動注射器）就像一次性打火機：整體不可拆，按一次打完，打完即丟。
blocks.en: Designation D1 (autoinjector) is like a disposable lighter: the whole unit cannot be taken apart, it discharges once, and it is thrown away after use.

blocks.zh: 兩者的劑量準確性測試邏輯完全不同——前者需要測試「每一個設定劑量的精準度」，後者測試「能否把整瓶藥完全打出」。
blocks.en: The dose accuracy test logic of the two is completely different: the former tests "the accuracy of every set dose", while the latter tests "whether the whole contents can be fully expelled".

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一個 adalimumab biosimilar 的 40 mg/0.8 mL 自動注射器，採用 PFS 固定整合在裝置內，一次性使用。請問其 System Designation 為何？
blocks.en: A 40 mg/0.8 mL adalimumab biosimilar autoinjector uses a PFS fixed integrally inside the device and is single use. What is its System Designation?

blocks.zh: 同一客戶另有一個可替換 PFS 版本的筆型注射器，可預設 0.4 mL 或 0.8 mL 劑量。System Designation 為何？
blocks.en: The same customer also has a pen injector version with a replaceable PFS, which can be preset to a 0.4 mL or 0.8 mL dose. What is its System Designation?

blocks.zh: D2 系統要求「無法重新啟動」，這個設計要求對 CDMO 充填製程有什麼影響？
blocks.en: A D2 system must be "incapable of being reactivated". What does this design requirement mean for the CDMO's filling process?

blocks.zh: 系統設計分類的邏輯框架
blocks.en: The Logical Framework of System Designations

blocks.zh: ISO 11608-1 的六大分類由兩個維度決定：
blocks.en: The six designations in ISO 11608-1 are determined by two dimensions:

blocks.zh: 這個分類直接決定了在 Section 9 測試矩陣中，哪些測試是 必做（Column A）、哪些是 選做（Column B）。
blocks.en: This classification directly determines which tests in the Section 9 test matrix are mandatory (Column A) and which are optional (Column B).

blocks.zh: Section 4: 統計符號深度解析 — 劑量準確性的數學基礎
blocks.en: Section 4: Statistical Symbols in Depth: The Mathematical Basis of Dose Accuracy

blocks.zh: 劑量準確性統計邏輯：從樣本到母群體
blocks.en: The Statistical Logic of Dose Accuracy: From Sample to Population

blocks.zh: ISO 11608-1 的劑量準確性驗證使用統計容許區間（Tolerance Interval）方法，而非簡單的「樣本平均值 ± 3σ」。
blocks.en: Dose accuracy verification in ISO 11608-1 uses a statistical tolerance interval method, not the simple "sample mean ± 3σ".

blocks.zh: 核心邏輯：
blocks.en: Core logic:

blocks.zh: 我們測量 n 支 NIS（每支做 R 個 replicate）
blocks.en: We measure n NIS (each with R replicates)

blocks.zh: 計算 x̄（平均值）和 s（標準差）
blocks.en: Calculate x̄ (mean) and s (standard deviation)

blocks.zh: 用 k 值擴大信心區間，確保 至少 95% 的母群體（p=0.95）落在規格內
blocks.en: Use the k value to widen the confidence interval, ensuring that at least 95% of the population (p=0.95) falls within specification

blocks.zh: n 越小 → k 越大（不確定性補償），測試越難通過
blocks.en: The smaller n is, the larger k is (compensating for uncertainty), and the harder the test is to pass

blocks.zh: 公式解讀：α 與 β 的切換邏輯
blocks.en: Interpreting the Formula: Switching Between α and β

blocks.zh: ISO 11608-1 採用「雙段式誤差規格」設計：
blocks.en: ISO 11608-1 uses a "two-segment error specification":

blocks.zh:
小劑量（V ≤ TP）：使用絕對誤差 ±α mL
  例：V_set = 0.1 mL，α = 0.02 mL
  允許範圍：0.08 ~ 0.12 mL（±20%）

大劑量（V > TP）：使用相對誤差 ±β%
  例：V_set = 1.0 mL，β = 5%
  允許範圍：0.95 ~ 1.05 mL（±5%）

轉換點 TP = α / (β/100)
blocks.en:
Small doses (V ≤ TP): use absolute error ±α mL
  Example: V_set = 0.1 mL, α = 0.02 mL
  Allowed range: 0.08 ~ 0.12 mL (±20%)

Large doses (V > TP): use relative error ±β%
  Example: V_set = 1.0 mL, β = 5%
  Allowed range: 0.95 ~ 1.05 mL (±5%)

Transition point TP = α / (β/100)

blocks.zh: 這個設計反映了計量學事實：小劑量的測量精度以絕對值表達更合理；大劑量以百分比更合理。
blocks.en: This design reflects a metrological fact: for small doses it makes more sense to express measurement accuracy as an absolute value, and for large doses as a percentage.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：k 值的直覺理解
blocks.en: Analogy: An Intuitive Feel for the k Value

blocks.zh: 想像你要訂購一批杯子，要求容量在 250 ± 10 mL 之間。你只能測量 5 個樣本。
blocks.en: Imagine you are ordering a batch of cups, with a required capacity of 250 ± 10 mL. You can only measure 5 samples.

blocks.zh: 如果 5 個樣本都在 248-252 mL（很均勻），你對整批貨物的信心很高。
blocks.en: If all 5 samples fall between 248 and 252 mL (very uniform), you have high confidence in the whole lot.

blocks.zh: 但如果 5 個樣本在 240-260 mL（很分散），即使平均值是 250，你不敢保證整批都合格。
blocks.en: But if the 5 samples range from 240 to 260 mL (widely scattered), even with a mean of 250 you cannot be sure the whole lot conforms.

blocks.zh: k 值就是這個「分散程度」的補償係數——s 大 → 需要更大的 k 才能保證同樣比例的合格率。Annex B 的大表就是預先算好不同 n 和 p 組合下的 k 值。
blocks.en: The k value is the compensation factor for this "spread": the larger s is, the larger the k needed to guarantee the same conforming proportion. The large tables in Annex B are the k values precomputed for different combinations of n and p.

blocks.zh: Gauge R&R 要求：測試設備的精度門檻
blocks.en: Gauge R&R Requirement: The Accuracy Threshold for Test Equipment

blocks.zh: Section 6.1 要求：Gauge R&R ≤ 20% of tolerance range（破壞性測試為 30%）。
blocks.en: Section 6.1 requires Gauge R&R ≤ 20% of the tolerance range (30% for destructive tests).

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO QC 的含義：
blocks.en: What this means for CDMO QC:

blocks.zh: 如果容許誤差範圍是 ±0.05 mL（total 0.10 mL），測試系統的 R&R 不得超過 0.02 mL
blocks.en: If the allowable error range is ±0.05 mL (0.10 mL in total), the R&R of the test system must not exceed 0.02 mL

blocks.zh: 客戶提交的 DV 報告應包含 Gauge R&R 研究，CDMO 在收到設備時需驗證
blocks.en: The customer's submitted DV report should include a Gauge R&R study, and the CDMO should verify it when the equipment is received

blocks.zh: 重力法（gravimetric）比體積法精度更高，這也是為何 ISO 11608-1 明確要求記錄 G<sub>meas</sub> 並換算為 V<sub>meas</sub>
blocks.en: The gravimetric method is more accurate than the volumetric method, which is why ISO 11608-1 explicitly requires G<sub>meas</sub> to be recorded and converted to V<sub>meas</sub>

blocks.zh: 某 NIS 的 V<sub>min</sub> = 0.2 mL，V<sub>max</sub> = 1.0 mL，絕對誤差 α = 0.04 mL，相對誤差 β = 4%。計算轉換點 TP = ?（提示：TP = α / (β/100)）
blocks.en: For an NIS with V<sub>min</sub> = 0.2 mL, V<sub>max</sub> = 1.0 mL, absolute error α = 0.04 mL and relative error β = 4%, calculate the transition point TP. (Hint: TP = α / (β/100))

blocks.zh: 在 V<sub>set</sub> = 0.5 mL（大於 TP）的情況下，上下規格限 U 和 L 各為多少？
blocks.en: At V<sub>set</sub> = 0.5 mL (greater than TP), what are the upper and lower specification limits U and L?

blocks.zh: 測試 Y=20 支 NIS，每支測 3 個 replicate（N=3）。若 x̄ = 0.495 mL，s = 0.008 mL，k<sub>act</sub> = (0.524 - 0.495)/0.008 = 3.625。從 Annex B 查 n=60（20×3）、p=0.95 的 k<sub>tar</sub> ≈ 1.95。此批是否合格？
blocks.en: Y = 20 NIS are tested, with 3 replicates each (N = 3). If x̄ = 0.495 mL, s = 0.008 mL, and k<sub>act</sub> = (0.524 - 0.495)/0.008 = 3.625, and from Annex B for n = 60 (20×3) and p = 0.95, k<sub>tar</sub> ≈ 1.95, does this batch pass?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 六大系統設計分類：容器可替換性 × 單/多劑量 × 全量/部分釋出 → 決定測試矩陣；CDMO 最常見的 autoinjector 屬 D1（整合式、單劑量、全量）
blocks.en: Six system designations: container replaceability × single/multi-dose × full/partial delivery → determines the test matrix; the autoinjector most common in CDMOs is D1 (integrated, single dose, full delivery)

blocks.zh: 雙段式誤差規格：小劑量用絕對誤差 ±α，大劑量用相對誤差 ±β%，轉換點 TP = α/(β/100)
blocks.en: Two-segment error specification: absolute error ±α for small doses, relative error ±β% for large doses, with transition point TP = α/(β/100)

blocks.zh: 統計容許區間方法：x̄ + k·s ≤ U 且 x̄ − k·s ≥ L；k 值從 Annex B 依 n 和 p 查表，補償小樣本的統計不確定性
blocks.en: Statistical tolerance interval method: x̄ + k·s ≤ U and x̄ − k·s ≥ L; the k value is looked up in Annex B by n and p, compensating for the statistical uncertainty of small samples

blocks.zh: Gauge R&R ≤ 20%：測試設備精度要求，確保測試結果的不確定性不主導合規判定；重力法是 ISO 11608-1 的推薦測量方法
blocks.en: Gauge R&R ≤ 20%: the accuracy requirement for test equipment, ensuring that the uncertainty of the test results does not dominate the compliance decision; the gravimetric method is the measurement method recommended by ISO 11608-1
